records.description: AI clinical co-pilot for psychology clinics — automates notes, scheduling, billing, and insurance follow-up so clinicians spend more time with patients.

RevelleCare Inc. is a Canadian telemedicine company building the country's first prescription compounded skincare platform for women in perimenopause and menopause. More than six million Canadian women are in this life stage, yet the skin changes driven by estrogen decline - collagen loss, thinning, dryness, loss of elasticity - are chronically underserved. Dermatology treats skin without addressing the hormonal cause; gynecology addresses hormones without offering skin-specific formulations. No Canadian company delivers prescription hormonal skincare directly to patients at home. RevelleCare closes that gap. Patients complete an online intake assessment, are reviewed by a licensed Canadian Nurse Practitioner, and receive their personalized prescription formulation shipped directly to their door - no clinic visit required, fully PIPEDA-compliant. Our four prescription formulations include the Estrogen Repair Cream (Estradiol 0.01% + Estriol 0.3%), Night Renewal Cream (Tretinoin 0.05% + Estriol 0.03%), Non-Hormonal Repair Cream (Niacinamide, Vitamin C, Peptides), and Intimate Estriol Cream (Estriol 0.5%). Priced at $115–$195 CAD per three-month supply, blended annual revenue per patient is CAD $650. We launch September 2026 in Ontario and BC, with national expansion in 2027. Traction to date includes Dr. M. Joanne Lemieux (University of Alberta) as Scientific Advisory Board Chair and a growing community of prospective patients through The Collective. RevelleCare is raising CAD $1.4M on a SAFE at a $6.0M valuation cap to complete our telemedicine platform, acquire our first 600 patients, and reach the 2,000-5,000 patient Series A milestone. Founded by Michèle Lunney (B.Comm, Dalhousie University; Lean Six Sigma Black Belt).

LIOR Pupillometry is developing an accessible, field-ready pupillometer that brings objective pupillary assessment closer to the front lines of care. Today, pupil checks are still often performed manually, making them subjective, inconsistent, and difficult to track. LIOR is building a handheld, easy-to-use device that delivers fast, objective pupil data in seconds, helping frontline providers identify concerning changes earlier and support better triage, documentation, and decision-making. Our initial focus is emergency medical services, critical care transport, military medics, sports safety, schools, and other environments where quick neurological screening can make a meaningful difference. By making quantitative pupillometry more affordable, portable, and practical outside the hospital, LIOR aims to close a major gap between advanced neurological assessment and real-world frontline care.

Seva Intelligence Inc is building agentic AI infrastructure for neurodivergent care. We unify fragmented therapy, school, and clinical data, surfacing patterns no single source could show. Parents save 12 hours a week. Clinicians save 35% of appointment time lost catching up.

Marlann is building the orchestration platform for clinical work in long-term care - AI infrastructure that makes sure clinical work finishes reliably every time, across every role and every shift. Incomplete workflows create compliance exposure and coordination overhead costing each home ~$600K per year. Marlann automates the entire chain from event detection to verified completion. From the moment an event is detected, we generate every required task, assign it to the right role, track it across shifts, and make sure nothing falls through. Every existing system either depends on human initiation and execution of work, or is built for episodic workflows that have a clean start and end. Marlann is built from the ground up for autonomous execution of continuous workflows than span many days, roles, and handoffs. This is a $9B global market with no platform owner. We have our first enterprise contract signed, and a distribution channel in motion covering 350 homes. We’re raising $1.5M pre-seed to fund beta deployment and expand to 30 sites, across 2-3 independent operators, and $1M ARR.

Sovereign, on-premise AI infrastructure for regulated environments. Vertically integrated stack — inference, EMR, video, scribe — on bare metal. Healthcare-first, extensible to legal, government, defence. Former Assistant Professor of Psychiatry at UofT, left to build NORHI. CCAB-certified Indigenous-owned, four CIPO patents pending, NVIDIA Inception.

Caredara™ is a rapid-response, in-home care activation platform that stabilizes seniors and families during moments of care disruption. When care breaks down, after hospital discharge, caregiver burnout, missed visits, or sudden health changes, Caredara™ deploys vetted PSWs, RPNs, and RNs within hours to provide immediate, short-term support in the home. Caredara™ is not a home care agency. It is an activation layer that fills the critical timing gap between crisis and continuity of care. Using a pre-funded Care Credits™ model, real-time matching, and a care-ready workforce, the platform enables healthcare providers, employers, and insurers to trigger rapid in-home support without delays, contracts, or administrative friction. This stabilization window reduces avoidable emergency visits, supports safer discharges, and allows for structured transitions into long-term care pathways such as public home care, private agencies, or community services. For employers, Caredara™ addresses the hidden workforce impact of caregiving by providing employees with immediate, on-demand support during care crises, protecting productivity, retention, and well-being. Caredara™ is currently building regional density in Ontario and working with healthcare and employer partners to pilot a new model of care delivery focused on speed, flexibility, and system integration.

TalkToMedi is an AI-native medical voice platform addressing a critical operational gap in outpatient healthcare: missed patient calls and overloaded clinic front desks. Clinics receive high volumes of repetitive calls for appointments, follow-ups, and general inquiries, yet staffing constraints often mean patients are routed to voicemail, resulting in lost revenue, delayed care, and administrative burnout.

NodeAI solves a critical problem in the lung cancer diagnostic journey. Patients who are diagnosed with lung cancer will undergo a test (EBUS-TBNA), whose results will determine the next step in treatment. NodeAI has developed an AI-augmented software platform that increases the accuracy of EBUS-TBNA from ~55% to 82%, delivering results in 6 seconds—turning what once took weeks into near-instantaneous insights. The system is both precise and simple, designed to be device and user agnostic, dramatically increasing access for patients who need it most.

NewCode Oncology is a Toronto‑based precision oncology company building the next generation of cancer diagnostics and clinical decision support. The company has developed an AI‑powered, whole‑transcriptome (RNA‑Seq) universal tumor classifier that leverages the full RNA signal of a tumor—rather than limited gene panels—to accurately determine cancer type, prognosis, and therapeutic direction.

Atorvia is a pre-clinical stage biotechnology company on a mission to end organ failure, starting in kidney. Leveraging Ai tools and biomarker research, the company translates biological insight into proprietary, transformative medicines to restore organ health and improve patient outcomes for currently untreatable diseases.

Aurmada is a technology company developing intelligent protection and sensing systems designed to enhance safety for people, infrastructure, and emerging robotic platforms. Our platform integrates advanced materials, embedded sensors, and real-time data capabilities into modular systems that can be deployed across wearables, equipment, and other physical environments. These systems are designed to detect impacts, monitor environmental conditions, and generate actionable safety data that can improve situational awareness and response. Our first product platform, Layer 1 Shield, demonstrates how protection and intelligence can be integrated into lightweight systems that move with the user rather than relying solely on external equipment. This approach enables a new category of safety infrastructure that is more adaptable, connected, and scalable. Aurmada’s technology is being developed in collaboration with leading research institutions and industry partners, with applications spanning security, public safety, industrial operations, defense-adjacent environments, and next-generation robotics. The company is also exploring how intelligent protection systems can support autonomous platforms and human-machine collaboration as robotics adoption accelerates globally. Our long-term vision is to build a new layer of intelligent safety infrastructure — systems that combine protection, sensing, and connectivity to help organizations better protect people, assets, and operations in complex environments.

MHCombiotic is a Canadian antimicrobial biotechnology company dedicated to addressing the global crisis of antimicrobial resistance through the discovery and development of next-generation, non-traditional antimicrobial technologies. The company has developed Combiotic, a proprietary platform of synergistic formulations that combine plant-derived bioactive compounds with inorganic salts to selectively disrupt bacterial membranes, eradicate biofilms, and enhance host healing responses without promoting resistance.

Cura Therapeutics is pioneering the next generation of first-in-class, multimodal, and site-directed immunotherapies that reprogram the immune system's defenses to fight complex diseases, including metastatic cancer, age-related conditions, pathogen infections, and other undisclosed applications.

Ameliogenix is developing AGXV Series, a pipeline of modular mRNA therapies that synergistically rewire cholesterol metabolism, offering tailored and personalized long-term control over lipid levels and reduced heart disease risk. Backed by a robust ecosystem including OBIO, MaRS, TIAP, Momentum AIR, Invest Ottawa, and FedDev, alongside academic partnerships with Carleton University and La Cite college, Ameliogenix is aggressively expanding its network to lead the next frontier of the mRNA therapeutics industry.

XRAI Glass is a health-focused accessibility start-up that turns spoken conversation into real-time subtitles on smart glasses (or a phone), helping people who are deaf or hard of hearing participate fully in everyday life without relying on lipreading or constantly asking others to repeat themselves. By reducing communication barriers, it can support better social connection, independence, and confidence in situations that directly affect wellbeing, including medical appointments, pharmacy visits, and care coordination.

TransCan Genomics (TCG) is a clinical genomics and data-infrastructure company dedicated to supporting healthcare systems worldwide through a public-private collaboration model. We deliver an integrated platform that combines clinical-grade testing, centralized genomic data systems, and advanced automation tools designed to help clinicians, laboratories, and health systems scale efficiently while maintaining control of their data. Across the globe, demand for genetic testing is rapidly growing, yet many healthcare systems struggle with limited analysis capacity, fragmented data infrastructure, and dependence on external commercial labs. TCG solves this by partnering with domestic accredited sequencing facilities and providing downstream technology layers to transforms raw sequencing into high-quality clinical results, unified data repositories, and real-time clinical decision tools. Our platform streamlines workflows end-to-end, from test ordering to report generation, and supports national genomic initiatives through secure, open, high-value data infrastructure. TCG's proprietary data management architecture supports genetic data residency, provides enhanced clinical insights, and streamlines charting workflows - enabling clinicians to spend more time on patient care with consistent, actionable outputs. Health systems benefit from scalable digital infrastructure, lower operating costs, and the ability to retain genomic data as a strategic national asset, while participating partner laboratories gain new revenue opportunities. Our customers include medical genetics clinics, regional health systems, public genomic programs, and research organizations seeking reliable, scalable, and data-secure clinical genomics solutions. With a first-mover advantage in public-sector partnerships and a model built for global expansion, TCG is positioned to become a leading service provider in a multi-billion-dollar international diagnostic genomic testing market.

Deep Interaction lab develops AI-native immersive tech clinically validated, purpose-built to transform mental health care. Unlocking ease of access, accuracy, and personalization from diagnostic to treatment. At scale.

CanVeer Biopharma is a privately owned pre-clinical biopharmaceutical startup advancing innovative therapeutics for chronic respiratory diseases with high unmet medical need. CanVeer’s lead program, AlveoShield™, an investigational new drug candidate, is being developed to potentially prevent and treat Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia (BPD). BPD is a severe chronic respiratory condition affecting preterm born infants who require oxygen support at birth to survive, however, the life saving oxygen causes permenant damage to the newborn's fragile lungs and lead to BPD. In North America annually there are over 140,000 preterm born infants at risk to develop BPD. Currently, there is no approved therapy to prevent or treat BPD. AlveoShield™ is designed to block the underlying molecular pathway driving lung injury, preventing BPD development and hence allowing normal lung development.

Developer of a motion-based digital therapy platform designed for pediatric rehabilitation purposes. Our games use camera-based motion tracking, interactive exercise activities, therapist-guided programs, and progress monitoring features, enabling pediatric healthcare providers and caregivers to support structured physical therapy engagement and track functional movement adherence.

Sidian is a B2B SaaS company building Dataguard, a contextual AI platform that automates data compliance for organizations that handle sensitive information. Dataguard integrates natively into Microsoft 365 workspaces, applying organization-defined dynamic policies to automatically detect and redact restricted entities before documents are shared, with full audit logging and zero-trust data processing built in. The need is acute in sectors where a single mishandled document carries serious legal and regulatory consequences. In law firms, Dataguard prevents the inadvertent disclosure of privileged client information, opposing counsel details, and case-sensitive data during document review and sharing. In healthcare and other vulnerable sectors, it enforces compliance with PIPEDA, HIPAA, and provincial privacy regulations by automatically stripping patient identifiers, diagnoses, and protected health information before they leave the organization's control. Unlike enterprise tools such as Microsoft Purview, which require significant IT overhead and licensing investment, Dataguard is purpose-built to be affordable, fast to deploy, and immediately usable by non-technical staff. Founded by a team with hands-on experience building automated redaction systems for Canadian intelligence services, Sidian brings deep founder-market fit to a compliance problem that affects thousands of professional practices across North America.

Solid4m is a life sciences technology company commercializing patented devices and methods for pharmaceutical formulation and solid-form discovery. Our platform enables rapid, high-throughput screening of drug candidates, helping pharmaceutical companies reduce R&D timelines/costs, accelerate development, and uncover valuable new intellectual property. Through technology licensing, contract research, and strategic partnerships, we help bring better medicines to market faster.

Genki is an easy-to-learn, easy-to-use, modern Operating System for independent eye care businesses. Built with the whole team and end-customer satisfaction in mind, Genki provides smart workflow automation that saves time, reduces errors and redefines the customer experience. With an end to end solution that replaces many existing tools, Genki seeks to be the #1 trusted partner and favorite secret ingredient behind successful, independent eye care businesses across the globe.

ConSoul is a technology company building AI-powered caregiving infrastructure for complex care transitions. The platform supports unpaid caregivers as operational decision-makers by translating emotional overwhelm into structured actions, coordination workflows, and benefit navigation. Using agentic AI and workflow orchestration, ConSoul helps caregivers manage post-discharge transitions, ongoing care coordination, and delegation across care circles — reducing cognitive load while improving stability for families, employers, and healthcare systems. ConSoul is designed to integrate into employer benefits, healthcare pilots, and partner ecosystems without adding staff or new workflows.

Advanced Cryoscience is building an end-to-end biomedical cold chain to provide organs, tissues, and cell therapies on demand. Our non-toxic, DMSO-free cryoprotectant aims to enable indefinite storage at clinically practical high-subzero temperatures while preserving post-thaw function. We stack our cryoprotectants with portable subzero biotransportation devices, modular biobanking infrastructure for long-term storage, and a logistics hub to build a complete cold chain.

DIA Labs is a medical device company dedicated to improving the quality of life and care for patients through continuous, data-driven health monitoring technologies. Our flagship innovation, AirSense, is the first continuous asthma monitoring wearable designed to transform how respiratory diseases are managed and studied.

OpenJustice is an open-source platform designed to enable legal professionals to effortlessly create and deploy customized AI models using plain language. Our mission aims to democratize access to artificial intelligence for the legal profession, enhancing accessibility, transparency and reliability of AI for legal applications.

EyeCareX is a Canadian healthtech startup transforming the delivery of eye care through AI-powered automation. Our platform enables patients to independently complete essential clinical vision tests, freeing up staff time, boosting clinic productivity, and increasing access to preventative vision care. By automating up to 40% of the eye exam workflow, we help clinics reduce appointment times, increase revenue capacity, and improve patient throughput. Since launching our MVP, we’ve deployed across 10 pilot clinics with $180K in committed ARR, achieved Health Canada clearance, and filed multiple patent applications in AI-driven workflow automation and computer vision. Our infrastructure is HIPAA-compliant and FDA submission is underway. We’ve raised over $450K in non-dilutive funding (NSERC, NRC IRAP, AWS) and $500K in founder capital to fuel R&D and early commercialization. Our leadership team includes former senior executives from Clearly (EssilorLuxottica), with deep expertise in clinical operations, AI/ML, and regulatory strategy. With strong traction, a validated product, and growing inbound demand, EyeCareX is at an inflection point; positioned to scale across North America and beyond.

Smart Workforce AI is an AI powered workforce intelligence company serving shift based industries. The platform applies advanced forecasting and optimization models to labor planning, enabling organizations to align staffing with demand in real time. By combining AI driven scheduling, compliance awareness, and workforce analytics, Smart Workforce AI delivers measurable improvements in labor efficiency, cost control, and workforce utilization. The company focuses on practical enterprise adoption with fast deployment and clear ROI.

Organizations across the medical and insurance sectors face growing volumes of complex, unstructured documentation, from large medical records to multi-source claim and IME files. Sky-Tech AI is a next-generation intelligence platform built to eliminate the friction, delay, and risk associated with unstructured data. The platform ingests large medical and claims files, often exceeding 2,000 pages, and converts them into structured, decision-ready summaries, chronologies, and reports in under 30 minutes. Enterprise-ready and fully transparent through the Vanta Trust Center, Sky-Tech AI is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant, enabling secure onboarding in a day, not weeks, so both individual professionals and enterprises can move from Chaos to Clarity with confidence.

1 in 3 people in North America has prediabetes, and every year, 5–10% progress to full diabetes, costing the healthcare system $400B annually. 70% of these cases are reversible with early lifestyle changes. We have developed a chronic disease management system for dietitians to give more efficient prediabetes treatment. By taking meal, exercise and glucose logging on the app, we can link it to a dashboard for dietitians to view in real-time. We use the data to create a personalized lifestyle plan for the dietitian to integrate into their treatment. With the dasboard, the dietitian can view if the patient is adhering between sessions. This results in more efficient sessions, reducing session length by 50% while maintaining session efficacy.

At SMYLS, we are at the forefront of the transforming Canadian healthcare industry, by specialize in helping Family Doctors tap into their unrealized uninsured services revenue - including missed appointments, forms, letters, and cosmetic procedures (e.g., wart or skin tag removal). Surprisingly, less than 60% of family doctors ever charge for these services, and even fewer charge appropriately. Our modern easy to use cloud solution is designed to simplify and streamline healthcare's revenue cycle management aimed at maximizing physician revenue. Our goal is to help family doctors generate up to 36% more in additional annual gross revenue, all while respecting / adhering to provincial and federal regulations and the standards set by the College of Physicians & Surgeons.

SiMLQ automatically creates scalable digital process twins for predictive and prescriptive simulations of queueing networks. Queues are everywhere including in Emergency Departments (EDs). SiMLQ facilitates these seamlessly and is one of the top 20 University Spin-Offs to watch globally . SiMLQ is collaborating with leaders in healthcare, and tech to drive process optimization in highly uncertain environments, where queueing and congestion affect KPIs, product quality, and user experience.

Moonrise Medical is a medtech company developing an automated ultrasound system to improve the diagnosis, management, and surgical guidance of Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD) and Diabetic Foot Ulcers (DFUs) conditions that lead to over 500 amputations every day in the U.S. alone.

Stoked Bio is creating the path of least resistance by reimagining how therapies for drug-resistant infections and cancer are discovered. Our biology-first platform integrates proprietary, disease-specific training data with machine learning to identify compounds with real biological effect, not just statistical noise. By increasing the odds of success, we can accelerate timelines through early pharma partnerships to deliver strong near-term investor value. Our portfolio continues to expand with novel therapeutic options to treat important resistant diseases.

LongTermGevity (LTG)'s lead invention is a first-in-class and first-to-market non-opioid, non-addictive topical pain medicine that targets pain modulation through serotonin pathways in the peripheral nervous system. LongTermGevity is uniquely positioned to execute its first-in-human trials and establish a new standard of care for chronic pain through safe, effective, and non-addictive therapeutics.

Illumacell is an early clinical stage, medical device company developing breakthrough photodynamic therapy (PDT) for cancer patients. Our patented “Wall of Light®”, LED device delivers high intensity red-light energy deep into tissues of the body offering physicians a non-invasive way to target cancer from outside the body. Illumacell PDT will impact the lives of millions of cancer patients with safe and less toxic treatment options compared to surgery, chemotherapy and radiation.

Zen Neuroscience is a neurotechnology company focused on transforming mental health care through non-invasive neuromodulation. Our first product is a portable, discreet device that delivers targeted, low-intensity ultrasound to the auricular branch of the vagus nerve.

Vrit Inc. is pioneering the future of wound care with INSITE, a handheld in-situ bioprinter, and SHIELD, an advanced bioink and stem-cell therapy platform. Together, these technologies enable off-the-shelf, autograft-free skin regeneration, addressing the limitations of split-thickness autografts the century-old standard for severe burns and trauma.

Blair automates healthcare admin work to create more human patient experiences with AI. Every other industry competes on customer experience except healthcare, where patients still face outdated portals and endless phone tag. We help providers deliver the seamless patient experience that people expect from modern brands.

HerSay is an AI-powered doctor visit companion built to help women prepare for, navigate, and follow up on medical appointments with confidence and clarity. Rooted in lived experience and backed by clinical research, HerSay addresses a critical gap in women's healthcare: feeling dismissed, overwhelmed, or unsupported during medical encounters.

Strello is building AI agents the medical front office. Our agents eliminate patient hold times, make healthcare more accessible, and reduce staff burden turning a team of five admins into the equivalent of ten. Outpatient medical clinics face heavy administrative burden. Front desks consume ~30% of operating costs and are overwhelmed by >150 daily calls, leaving clinics both expensive to run and losing up to $250K annually in uncaptured revenue.

MWX builds, deploys, and licenses digital environments. Think visualization of engineering, planning & architecture, seaport & airports, resorts, medical campuses and entire cities. A non stagnant and digital interactive version. A MetaWorld for the purpose of information, data analysis, risk management, marketing, exploration, and positive social impact.

Gecera Biosciences is an AI-driven platform accelerating next-generation cell and gene therapies. Our agentic AI streamlines design, de-risks CMC, and enables scalable non-viral gene-delivery solutions for gene-replacement and gene-editing programs. With an edge-device-ready prototype for real-time predictive modelling, we provide end-to-end design, IP, and manufacturability insights that help biopharma teams develop safer, faster, and more reliable therapies.

Flourish is dedicated to making bespoke healthcare accessible to anyone who isn't the top 1%. We transform wearable data and subjective accounts of patient health into personalized action plans that build long-term health. The plans are delivered via 1:1 coaching with healthcare experts without the need for invasive blood tests or scans. Users experience better energy, mood and health outcomes.

KixCare is Canada's only national, bilingual virtual care company dedicated to pediatrics. Founded by physicians, KixCare's team of pediatric experts offers comprehensive 24/7 physical and mental healthcare for children 0-17 anytime, anywhere.

NexScale is a Toronto-based AI startup with the vision of making AI adoption accessible for small businesses. We focus on high-touch, service-based industries to enable them scale faster and smarter; without needing a tech team or technical skills. We offer an agentic AI SaaS solution that acts as the AI business partner and simplifies daily operations, reduce manual work, and enhance customer experience and retention. Currently focused on the wellbeing and fitness sectors across the U.S. and Canada, NexScale helps business owners automate workflows, improve efficiency, and unlock new growth opportunities—eliminating the complexity of traditional software solutions through low change management. Backed by nearly two decades of experience in B2B product innovation and technical leadership, NexScale combines deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of small business realities to deliver measurable, lasting results. Founded by a serial tech entrepreneur for entrepreneurs ready to move from burnout to growth.

Corvita Biomedical Inc. is a Canadian health technology company developing the ARK Incubator, an integrated neonatal intensive care platform designed to address systemic inequities in newborn diagnosis, reduce the prohibitive costs of delivering NICU services, and enable hospitals to scale their capacity without proportional increases in staffing or infrastructure.

ExactBlue is revolutionizing infection prevention by using nanotechnology to deliver ultra-fast, lab quality microbial testing at the point of sampling. As a result of recent R&D breakthroughs, we now have the world’s fastest and most sensitive tests for microbial contamination. The nanotechnology that we have developed can be used either as a quick and simple qualitative test for contamination from total bacteria, e-coli, coliform, pseudomonas and others, or as a quantitative detection system. We provide fast and reliable information as part of a comprehensive infection control program for infection prevention companies, on-site and with minimal training required.

Enabled Talent delivers an end-to-end inclusive workforce solution, combining AI-powered job matching, accessibility tools and training. We help businesses unlock untapped talent, boost productivity, and integrate diverse abilities into the workplace turning inclusion into a measurable driver of performance, innovation, and long-term growth.

YYZ Pharmatech Inc. (“YYZ”) is a deep tech company committed to advancing transformative medicines for patients by revealing first-in-class and novel cell-surface co-receptor drug targets that others miss. YYZ's platform characterizes cell-surface receptor complexes with unprecedented sensitivity to derive the most compelling drug targets for new therapies. YYZ is a member of JLABS and a spinout from Professor John G. Marshall's laboratory at Toronto Metropolitan University. Our pioneering science is built on a foundation of +150 publications and extensive collaboration with leading international institutions.

Chapeau! is a digital product studio that builds custom software for information-rich organizations. Our innovative portals and field systems integrate existing architecture and data for better business performance and client experiences. We work in environments where stakes are high, workflows fragmented and problems wicked. We simplify without sacrifice: designing what really matters. We work in finance, environmental testing, healthcare, education, utilities and more. Our clients trust us to collaborate with stakeholders, understand how they operate, and deliver valued software experiences. Our innovation process means we work with what you have. No forced rebuilds. No fixing what ain't broke. Chapeau! delivers quick wins, long-term scalability and plans that flex to your budget and capacity.

Blue Bend Medical Technologies is a MedTech innovator focused on transforming spine fusion surgery for Adult Spine Deformity (ASD). Our mission is to improve patient outcomes, reduce costly revision surgeries, and ease the significant economic burden on healthcare systems. Our patented, AI-driven software-hardware platform predicts postoperative alignment, estimates mechanical complications, and enables precise intraoperative implant contouring. At Blue Bend, what matters most is advancing patient care—because every innovation should begin and end with the patient.

Humine is a digital health startup that streamlines clinical trial screening and eligibility verification by empowering patients with self-sovereign control over their real-world health data, building trust in research from the outset. Humine's infrastructure layer, zClinical™ (patent-pending), leverages Zero-Knowledge proofs to privately verify attributes of sensitive health data to requesters without any transmission or exposure. Built on industry standards, Humine’s patient-facing mobile app embeds zClinical to enable selective disclosure of health history from EHR- and wearable-derived data modalities.

smartARM is a Toronto-based innovator specializing in AI-powered bionic prosthetics designed to enhance human autonomy. Their flagship product integrates a vision system with machine learning to enable intuitive, adaptive grasping. By leveraging Microsoft Azure's Computer Vision and cloud storage, smartARM's prosthetic hand recognizes objects and selects the most appropriate grip, learning and improving over time. This approach offers a cost-effective alternative to traditional prosthetics, aiming to provide greater accessibility and functionality for users. Smartarm is a member of the Mobility Unlimited Hub cohort at MaRS.

ImaginAble Solutions is a women-led social impact company creating assistive technology to improve the quality of life for people with disabilities. Their lead product, Guided Hands®, enables people with limited hand mobility to write, paint, draw, and use touch-screen devices—simple tasks many take for granted. Founder Lianna created the first prototype for her friend with Cerebral Palsy and received the Muhammad Ali Humanitarian Award for her team’s impact on the disability community. Guided Hands® is used across 25 countries, bringing tears of joy to parents as they watch their child write or draw for the first time, finally able to express themselves and gain independence. ImaginAble Solutions is a member of the Mobility Unlimited Hub cohort at MaRS.

BirchBioMed is at the forefront of biopharmaceutical innovation, focusing on the development of advanced treatments for fibrosis and certain autoimmune disorders. Our science centers around the therapeutic potential of Kynurenic Acid (KynA), also known as ‘FS2’, a compound with notable antifibrogenic properties capable of enhancing extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling. At BirchBioMed, we leverage KynA across a range of applications: topical creams, systemic administration, and a pioneering approach, known as AI-001, that combines a one-time delivery of APCs with systemic KynA administration to produce a synergistic effect in the treatment of certain autoimmune conditions. Our multidisciplinary strategy embodies the latest in scientific research to address complex medical challenges. The active use of KynA in our treatments targets the foundational aspects of fibrosis and, in combination with APCs, produces synergistic immune regulation in some clinical subsets of autoimmune disorders, offering new hope in managing severe conditions. This innovative approach reflects our commitment to pushing the boundaries of medical science, relentlessly exploring new therapeutic pathways and advanced treatment modalities to improve patient outcomes.

Synod Intellicare is a health-tech organization focused on advancing ethical AI for bias detection and equitable decision-making in healthcare. The project aims to enhance transparency, fairness, and accountability in clinical AI systems through its proprietary tool, the Data Diversity & Fairness Auditor (DDFA). DDFA is designed to identify and quantify systemic bias in healthcare data at the point of care, with zero additional cognitive load on clinicians. The DDFA flags bias before harm occurs. And it builds the evidence base hospitals need to prove their AI is fair, to regulators, to boards, and to their patients and communities.

Terno is an AI data scientist that helps businesses unlock the power of their data without needing a dedicated analytics team. By combining advanced AI, machine learning, and data visualization tools, Terno automatically generates insights, forecasts, and reports tailored to your business needs. It empowers teams to explore data, run queries, and make smarter decisions, all through an easy-to-use platform that ensures data security and accuracy. Perfect for organizations, Terno turns complex data into actionable strategies, helping you stay agile and data-driven. You can install Terno on local or just connect your DB on terno.ai and start getting instant, 100% accurate insights on your data. We combine enterprise-grade security and accuracy, to deliver a solution that scales across industries like finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and retail. Traction: 5 paying B2B customers 30+ Proof-of-Concept deployments Zero marketing spend to date With Terno.AI, organizations can make faster, data-driven decisions, reduce analytics costs, and unlock the full potential of their data infrastructure.

Synth-Med is revolutionizing drug delivery by leveraging the unique properties of red blood cells (RBCs), the body’s most abundant and naturally biocompatible carriers. RBCs have low immunogenicity and an exceptionally long circulation half-life, making them ideal for therapeutic delivery. While others have attempted similar approaches, Synth-Med is the first to overcome key technical barriers without relying on gene therapy. Our proprietary platform enables targeted delivery of a wide range of drug types. Our lead asset delivers a memory-enhancing molecule to the brain, addressing a critical unmet need in Alzheimer’s disease and opening new frontiers in disease treatment.

Duniya Health is a Canadian digital health company dedicated to transforming cancer care through patient-centred, evidence-based technology. Founded in Ontario, the company was born out of the lived experience of caregiving for a young breast cancer patient and the recognition of critical gaps in how patients and providers manage complex treatment journeys. Our flagship platform empowers oncology patients to manage treatment side effects, track symptoms, and access validated self-management strategies tailored to their individual needs. By integrating with major electronic health record systems (Epic, Cerner, Meditech, Telus Health), Duniya Health ensures continuity of care, streamlines provider workflows, and reduces administrative burden. For patients and caregivers, Duniya Health provides accessible, culturally sensitive, and multilingual support that reduces uncertainty, strengthens engagement, and addresses inequities in access to care. Duniya Health operates on a B2B SaaS model, licensing to hospitals and health systems. The company is building towards pilot deployments in Canada and the Middle East, with a roadmap that includes rigorous outcome evaluation and full commercialization by 2026.

Nytia Labs provides a SaMD(Software as a Medical Device) platform that uses genetics, genomics & lifestyle data to fill the gap on chronic deseases(NCD) prevention and early detection in precision medecine.

Atabazh Medical is a pre-seed medical device company developing Smart Lung Physio, a bedside respiratory therapy solution designed to improve airway clearance delivery in long-term care and home-care settings. The company focuses on addressing a critical gap in respiratory care where treatment quality is highly manual, caregiver-dependent, and difficult to standardize across patients and environments. Smart Lung Physio integrates applied sensing and guided feedback to support more consistent therapy delivery while reducing staff burden. Atabazh Medical is currently engaged in early-stage validation, clinical workflow discovery, and prototype development, working closely with healthcare stakeholders to ensure alignment with real-world care environments and regulatory pathways. QN⊗T combines artificial intelligence (AI) and quantum computing (QC) to address complex industry challenges. At the core of QN⊗T’s strategy are AI-driven models like Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs), which harness quantum-enhanced machine learning to optimize computations and generate deeper insights. These models bridge classical and quantum systems by transforming classical data into quantum states, enabling advanced problem-solving capabilities. In pharmaceuticals, QN⊗T accelerates drug discovery by employing hybrid quantum-classical models to solve the protein folding problem. This approach determines the lowest energy configurations of amino acid sequences, streamlining research and development processes. As a result, the development of personalized medicine is faster, more cost-efficient, and more precise. In cancer prognosis, QN⊗T explores innovative applications of quantum random number generators (QRNGs). QRNGs leverage the inherent randomness of quantum mechanics to generate truly unpredictable sequences, improving the accuracy and reliability of probabilistic models used in medical diagnostics. Predictive models in cancer rely on analyzing complex biological data, such as genetic mutations and biomarker variations, where QRNGs reduce biases associated with traditional pseudo-random methods. This enhances the robustness of predictions for disease progression and treatment outcomes. QRNG-powered algorithms optimize cancer risk assessments by analyzing massive genomic datasets, identifying patterns linked to specific cancer types or stages. This enables precise prognostic tools tailored to individual profiles, supporting early diagnosis and personalized treatment plans. With compatibility for the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, QN⊗T ensures cost-effective, high-performance solutions, demonstrating its commitment to advancing oncology and global healthcare.
